title: Your Number's Up
summary: A woman is found stabbed at a local retirement home, while a bingo game is taking place.
method: The victim was stabbed, left the room, and took steps to protect the killer
motive: The killer found out that the victim had assumed a fake identity to enter Saint Marie. While faking the death of this fictional person, the killer's father tried to save them but died in the process.
notes: The detective who pretends to be the second cousin of the victim and is offered money for her silence should also be charged. It doesn't make sense why she makes an attempt to run away.
